translations.web: Let your beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on fine clothing;
translations.bsb: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
translations.kjv: Whose adorning let it ➔ not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
